x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description:
There is another app Pattern Designer which was released before PAD and it also has a User Role called 'pd_admin' with a different sysId. When both apps are installed, the platform merges Contained Roles records referencing 'pd_admin' from both apps under a single 'pd_admin' User Role, which ever 'pd_admin' User Role existed on the system first. This creates a security issue. For example if both apps are installed and PAD was installed first, then users who were given the 'pd_admin' role only for accessing PAD will now be able to access Pattern Designer APIs.
This Fix Script addresses two issues:
- If only PAD is installed, swap users with 'pd_admin' role with the new 'playbook.admin' role, then delete the 'pd_admin' User Role. - If both Pattern Designer and PAD are installed, give users with 'pd_admin' role the new role 'playbook.admin'. We will communicate to our customers that it will be up to them to decide which roles to keep for each user, 'pd_admin' or 'playbook.admin', or both.
Existing sys_user_role_contains records referencing 'pd_admin' will be marked with action="DELETE" and new ones referencing 'playbook.admin' will be created in order to ensure the 'pd_admin' role will no longer contain any PAD roles, regardless which app was installed first.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Remove pd_admin conditionally
